questions.question: Which database is used by the Notification Service to store transactional notifications?
expected_facts: Notification Dispatch Service writes to and reads from database:notification-pg.
questions.reference_answer: The Notification Dispatch Service (service:notification-service) uses the PostgreSQL notification database (database:notification-pg) for storing transactional notifications.

questions.question: Who is the team lead for the Identity and Access Management Team?
expected_facts: Marcus Vance is the team lead for the Identity and Access Management Team.
questions.reference_answer: Marcus Vance is the designated Team Lead for the Identity and Access Management Team (team:identity-access).

questions.question: What is the severity score and vulnerability identifier for the runc container breakout in Payment Gateway?
expected_facts: CVE-2024-21626 has a severity score of 9.8 CRITICAL.
CVE-2024-21626 impacts Payment Gateway Service (service:payment-gateway).
questions.reference_answer: The runc container breakout vulnerability is identified as CVE-2024-21626 (vuln:cve-2024-21626) with a severity rating of 9.8 CRITICAL.

questions.question: Which team owns the Cart Service?
expected_facts: Shopping Cart Service is owned by the Checkout Engineering Team (team:checkout-engineering).
questions.reference_answer: The Shopping Cart Service (service:cart-service) is owned and operated by the Checkout Engineering Team (team:checkout-engineering).

questions.question: What database engine and version powers the Product Catalog Service?
expected_facts: Product Catalog MongoDB uses MongoDB 6.0 engine.
questions.reference_answer: The Product Catalog database (database:catalog-mongodb) runs on MongoDB 6.0.

questions.question: What HTTP endpoint is exposed by the Process Payment Charge API v2?
expected_facts: api:process-charge-v2 endpoint is POST /v2/charges.
questions.reference_answer: The Process Payment Charge API v2 (api:process-charge-v2) exposes the endpoint 'POST /v2/charges'.

questions.question: Which infrastructure cluster hosts the Warehouse Management Service in the US-West region?
expected_facts: Warehouse Management Service is deployed on infra:k8s-prod-cluster-us-west.
questions.reference_answer: The Warehouse Management Service is deployed on the Kubernetes Production Cluster US-West (infra:k8s-prod-cluster-us-west).

questions.question: What Slack channel does the Cloud Infrastructure and SRE Team use?
expected_facts: The Cloud Infrastructure and SRE Team communicates in #proj-cloud-infra.
questions.reference_answer: The Cloud Infrastructure and SRE Team uses the Slack channel #proj-cloud-infra.

questions.question: What is the primary architectural purpose of the Search Pipeline Indexer?
expected_facts: Search Pipeline Indexer consumes product updates and indexes documents into Elasticsearch.
questions.reference_answer: The Search Pipeline Indexer consumes product update events and indexes documents into Elasticsearch for fast search queries.

questions.question: Which repository stores the source code for the Billing and Invoicing Service?
expected_facts: Billing and Invoicing Service source code is stored in repo:billing-service-repo.
questions.reference_answer: The source code for the Billing and Invoicing Service is stored in repo:billing-service-repo (github.com/aegis/billing-service).

questions.question: Which services are owned by the team that maintains the Payment Gateway Service?
expected_facts: Payment Gateway Service is owned by Checkout Engineering Team.
Checkout Engineering Team also owns Checkout Service and Shopping Cart Service.
questions.reference_answer: The Payment Gateway Service is owned by the Checkout Engineering Team (team:checkout-engineering), which also owns the Checkout Service (service:checkout-service) and the Shopping Cart Service (service:cart-service).

questions.question: Which databases are written to by the service that exposes the Create Order API v2?
expected_facts: api:create-order-v2 is exposed by Checkout Service.
Checkout Service writes transactions to Customer Orders PostgreSQL (database:customer-orders-pg).
questions.reference_answer: The Create Order API v2 is exposed by the Checkout Service (service:checkout-service), which writes to the Customer Orders PostgreSQL database (database:customer-orders-pg).

questions.question: What team owns the database that stores user accounts and password hashes for the Authentication Service?
expected_facts: Authentication Service reads from database:user-directory-pg.
database:user-directory-pg is owned by Identity and Access Management Team.
questions.reference_answer: The User Directory PostgreSQL database (database:user-directory-pg) used by the Authentication Service is owned and operated by the Identity and Access Management Team (team:identity-access).

questions.question: Which teams maintain services that write to the Customer Orders Database?
expected_facts: Checkout Service writes to Customer Orders Database.
Checkout Service is maintained by the Checkout Engineering Team.
questions.reference_answer: The Checkout Engineering Team (team:checkout-engineering) maintains the Checkout Service (service:checkout-service), which writes to the Customer Orders Database (database:customer-orders-pg).

questions.question: Which services depend on the Authentication Service and what teams own them?
expected_facts: Checkout Service and Payment Gateway depend on Authentication Service.
Both services are owned by the Checkout Engineering Team.
questions.reference_answer: The Checkout Service (service:checkout-service) and Payment Gateway (service:payment-gateway) depend on the Authentication Service; both are owned by the Checkout Engineering Team (team:checkout-engineering).

questions.question: What is the remote GitHub repository URL for the service impacted by CVE-2024-3094?
expected_facts: CVE-2024-3094 impacts Authentication Service.
Authentication Service source code repository is github.com/aegis/auth-service.
questions.reference_answer: CVE-2024-3094 impacts the Authentication Service (service:auth-service), whose repository is located at github.com/aegis/auth-service (repo:auth-service-repo).

questions.question: Which database does the Shopping Cart Service depend on through its upstream service connections?
expected_facts: Cart Service depends on Inventory Service.
Inventory Service reads and writes to Warehouse Inventory PostgreSQL (database:inventory-pg).
questions.reference_answer: The Shopping Cart Service depends on the Inventory Reservation Service (service:inventory-service), which connects directly to the Warehouse Inventory PostgreSQL database (database:inventory-pg).

questions.question: Who is the team lead of the group that owns the repository storing code for the Data Pipeline Ingestion Engine?
expected_facts: Data Pipeline Engine is owned by Data Platform Team.
Elena Rostova is the lead of the Data Platform Team.
questions.reference_answer: Elena Rostova leads the Data Platform Team (team:data-platform), which owns the data pipeline repository (repo:data-pipeline-repo) and service (service:data-pipeline-service).

questions.question: Which API does the Support Ticketing Service invoke to look up placed orders?
expected_facts: Support Ticketing Service depends on Checkout Service.
Ticketing Service calls api:get-order-status-v1 to retrieve order history.
questions.reference_answer: The Support Ticketing Service invokes api:get-order-status-v1 (exposed by the Checkout Service) to look up customer order records.

questions.question: Which team owns the service affected by the HTTP/2 Rapid Reset vulnerability (CVE-2023-44487)?
expected_facts: CVE-2023-44487 impacts Checkout Service.
Checkout Service is owned by Checkout Engineering Team.
questions.reference_answer: The Checkout Engineering Team (team:checkout-engineering) owns the Checkout Service (service:checkout-service), which is impacted by CVE-2023-44487.

questions.question: Which downstream service does the Notification Dispatch Service invoke for SMS message delivery?
expected_facts: Notification Service depends on SMS Relay Gateway.
Notification Service calls api:send-sms-v1 on service:sms-relay-service.
questions.reference_answer: The Notification Dispatch Service depends on the SMS Relay Gateway (service:sms-relay-service) and calls api:send-sms-v1 for SMS delivery.

questions.question: What database infrastructure stores customer contact information synchronized by the CRM Sync Service?
expected_facts: CRM Sync Service writes contact records to database:crm-ticketing-pg.
CRM Sync Service connects to User Directory Service for account details.
questions.reference_answer: The CRM Sync Service synchronizes contact information into the Support CRM PostgreSQL database (database:crm-ticketing-pg).

questions.question: Which team lead oversees the team responsible for double-entry financial ledger records?
expected_facts: Billing and Finance Tech Team maintains the financial ledger.
Ananya Patel is the team lead of Billing and Finance Tech Team.
questions.reference_answer: Ananya Patel is the team lead for the Billing and Finance Tech Team (team:billing-finance), which maintains the Financial General Ledger database (database:financial-ledger-pg).

questions.question: What cloud infrastructure hosts the database used by the User Directory Service?
expected_facts: User Directory Service uses database:user-directory-pg.
database:user-directory-pg is deployed on AWS RDS PostgreSQL Multi-AZ Cluster.
questions.reference_answer: The User Directory PostgreSQL database (database:user-directory-pg) is hosted on the AWS RDS PostgreSQL Multi-AZ Cluster (infra:aws-rds-postgres-cluster).

questions.question: Which service calls the Tax Calculation API v1 and which team manages it?
expected_facts: Billing and Invoicing Service calls api:calculate-tax-v1.
Both services are managed by the Billing and Finance Tech Team.
questions.reference_answer: The Billing and Invoicing Service (service:billing-service) calls api:calculate-tax-v1, and both services are managed by the Billing and Finance Tech Team (team:billing-finance).

questions.question: Which databases are written to by services that depend on the User Directory Service?
expected_facts: Authentication Service and Support Ticketing Service depend directly on User Directory Service.
Authentication Service writes to database:auth-session-redis.
Support Ticketing Service writes to database:crm-ticketing-pg.
questions.reference_answer: Services depending on the User Directory Service include the Authentication Service (which writes to database:auth-session-redis) and the Support Ticketing Service (which writes to database:crm-ticketing-pg).

questions.question: If the Payment Gateway Service fails, which downstream teams and services in the checkout pipeline are impacted?
expected_facts: Checkout Service directly depends on Payment Gateway.
Support Ticketing Service depends on Checkout Service.
Impacts Checkout Engineering Team and Customer Support Engineering Team.
questions.reference_answer: Failure of the Payment Gateway impacts the Checkout Service (owned by Checkout Engineering Team) and transitively impacts the Support Ticketing Service (owned by Customer Support Engineering Team).

questions.question: What infrastructure VPC enclaves are traversed when a user places an order via the Shopping Cart Service?
expected_facts: Cart Service connects to Checkout Service and Payment Gateway.
Payment Gateway operates inside the PCI Isolated Secure VPC (infra:pci-isolated-vpc).
All services run on Kubernetes Production Cluster US-East (infra:k8s-prod-cluster-us-east).
questions.reference_answer: Placing an order traverses the primary Kubernetes cluster (infra:k8s-prod-cluster-us-east) and reaches into the hardened PCI Isolated Secure VPC (infra:pci-isolated-vpc) hosting the Payment Gateway and payment vault.

questions.question: Which teams maintain the upstream services and databases required by the Billing and Invoicing Service for payment capture?
expected_facts: Payment Gateway depends on Billing Service.
Payment Gateway and payment vault are maintained by the Checkout Engineering Team.
questions.reference_answer: The Checkout Engineering Team (team:checkout-engineering) maintains the Payment Gateway Service and Payment Vault PostgreSQL database (database:payment-vault-pg) required for capturing charges and recording billing ledgers.

questions.question: What is the full dependency chain from the Support Ticketing Service down to the authentication and session storage layer?
expected_facts: Support Ticketing Service depends on User Directory Service and Checkout Service.
Authentication Service depends on User Directory Service and reads/writes to Redis and PostgreSQL stores.
questions.reference_answer: The Support Ticketing Service depends on the User Directory Service, which directly supports the Authentication Service, which in turn writes session tokens to Redis (database:auth-session-redis) and reads profiles from database:user-directory-pg.

questions.question: Which databases are populated downstream when inventory is reserved through an order placed on the Shopping Cart?
expected_facts: Cart Service calls Inventory Service.
Inventory Service coordinates with Warehouse Service.
Both services persist stock updates to Warehouse Inventory PostgreSQL (database:inventory-pg).
questions.reference_answer: Inventory reservations initiated via the Shopping Cart Service flow through the Inventory Reservation Service and Warehouse Management Service, persisting lock states to the Warehouse Inventory PostgreSQL database (database:inventory-pg).

questions.question: What security vulnerabilities affect services that write data to the customer order or payment databases?
expected_facts: Checkout Service writes to customer-orders-pg and is affected by CVE-2023-44487.
Payment Gateway writes to payment-vault-pg and is affected by CVE-2024-21626.
questions.reference_answer: The Checkout Service (writing to database:customer-orders-pg) is affected by CVE-2023-44487 (HTTP/2 Rapid Reset), while the Payment Gateway (writing to database:payment-vault-pg) is affected by CVE-2024-21626 (runc container escape).

questions.question: Which teams oversee the infrastructure and service layers involved in streaming database changes to the analytics data warehouse?
expected_facts: Data Platform Team owns Data Pipeline Ingestion Engine, Kafka event bus, and ClickHouse analytics warehouse.
questions.reference_answer: The Data Platform Team (team:data-platform) oversees the entire CDC streaming pipeline, including the Data Pipeline Service, Kafka Event Bus, and the ClickHouse Analytics Warehouse.

questions.question: What is the blast radius on customer communication channels if the SMS Relay Gateway experiences an outage?
expected_facts: Notification Dispatch Service relies on SMS Relay Gateway.
Outage prevents delivery of two-factor authentication (2FA) codes and critical SMS alerts.
questions.reference_answer: An outage in the SMS Relay Gateway halts downstream SMS delivery for the Notification Dispatch Service, blocking two-factor authentication tokens and customer alert dispatches.

questions.question: Which teams maintain services that participate in asynchronous event publishing via the Kafka Event Bus?
expected_facts: Checkout Engineering, Inventory Fulfillment, Notification Messaging, Catalog Search, Data Platform, and Security SecOps teams maintain services deployed on Kafka.
questions.reference_answer: Teams maintaining services that publish or consume through the Kafka Event Bus include Checkout Engineering, Inventory & Fulfillment, Notification Messaging, Catalog & Search, Data Platform, and Enterprise Security.

questions.question: List all services deployed on the Kubernetes Production Cluster US-East (infra:k8s-prod-cluster-us-east).
expected_facts: Primary services deployed on US-East Kubernetes cluster include Checkout, Payment Gateway, Auth, Inventory, Catalog, Notification, Billing, and User Directory services.
questions.reference_answer: Services deployed on the US-East Kubernetes Production Cluster include Checkout Service, Payment Gateway, Authentication Service, Inventory Service, Catalog Service, Notification Service, Billing Service, SMS Relay, Tax Calculator, User Directory, Shopping Cart, Search Indexer, Data Pipeline, Analytics Aggregator, Ticketing Service, CRM Sync, Audit Logger, WAF Manager, and Cluster Orchestrator.

questions.question: List all critical severity (CVSS >= 9.0) security vulnerabilities and their impacted services across the enterprise.
expected_facts: CVE-2024-21626 (9.8 CRITICAL) impacts Payment Gateway.
CVE-2024-3094 (10.0 CRITICAL) impacts Authentication Service.
CVE-2024-23897 (9.8 CRITICAL) impacts Data Pipeline Service.
CVE-2023-38545 (9.8 CRITICAL) impacts SMS Relay Gateway.
CVE-2023-50164 (9.8 CRITICAL) impacts Support Ticketing Service.
questions.reference_answer: Critical severity CVEs include: CVE-2024-21626 (9.8 CRITICAL, Payment Gateway), CVE-2024-3094 (10.0 CRITICAL, Authentication Service), CVE-2024-23897 (9.8 CRITICAL, Data Pipeline), CVE-2023-38545 (9.8 CRITICAL, SMS Relay), and CVE-2023-50164 (9.8 CRITICAL, Support Ticketing).

questions.question: Which teams own services that interface directly with relational PostgreSQL databases?
expected_facts: Checkout Engineering operates PostgreSQL database workloads.
Identity Access operates PostgreSQL database workloads.
Inventory Fulfillment operates PostgreSQL database workloads.
Notification Messaging operates PostgreSQL database workloads.
Billing Finance operates PostgreSQL database workloads.
Customer Support Engineering operates PostgreSQL database workloads.
Data Platform operates PostgreSQL database workloads.
questions.reference_answer: Teams operating services that connect directly to PostgreSQL instances include Checkout Engineering, Identity & Access, Inventory & Fulfillment, Notification Messaging, Billing & Finance, Customer Support Engineering, and Data Platform.

questions.question: What are all the APIs exposed by the Authentication Service and what endpoints do they bind to?
expected_facts: Authentication Service exposes api:validate-token-v1 (POST /v1/oauth/validate).
Authentication Service exposes api:issue-jwt-v2 (POST /v2/oauth/token).
questions.reference_answer: The Authentication Service exposes api:validate-token-v1 (POST /v1/oauth/validate) for token verification and api:issue-jwt-v2 (POST /v2/oauth/token) for issuing JWT credentials.

questions.question: List all services owned by the Inventory and Fulfillment Team and the databases they read or write to.
expected_facts: Inventory and Fulfillment Team owns Inventory Reservation Service and Warehouse Management Service.
Both services read and write to Warehouse Inventory PostgreSQL (database:inventory-pg).
questions.reference_answer: The Inventory and Fulfillment Team owns the Inventory Reservation Service (service:inventory-service) and Warehouse Management Service (service:warehouse-service); both interface with the Warehouse Inventory PostgreSQL database (database:inventory-pg).

questions.question: Which architecture decision records (ADRs) are owned or sponsored by the Data Platform Team?
expected_facts: Data Platform Team sponsored ADR-101 (PostgreSQL pgvector), ADR-107 (Dual-Store Invariant), and ADR-111 (Debezium CDC Pipeline).
questions.reference_answer: ADRs sponsored by the Data Platform Team include ADR-101 (PostgreSQL with pgvector for Vector Search), ADR-107 (Dual-Store Invariant for Enterprise Knowledge Graph), and ADR-111 (Debezium CDC Pipeline for ClickHouse Analytics).

questions.question: What caching technologies and clusters are utilized across Aegis Global Technologies microservices?
expected_facts: Redis 7 clusters are utilized for auth session caching and shopping cart temporary storage on AWS ElastiCache.
questions.reference_answer: Aegis utilizes Redis 7 clusters hosted on AWS ElastiCache, specifically database:auth-session-redis (for session tickets and rate limits) and database:cart-redis (for shopping cart basket storage).

questions.question: List all repositories maintained by the Checkout Engineering Team.
expected_facts: Checkout Engineering Team manages checkout-service-repo and payment-gateway-repo.
questions.reference_answer: The Checkout Engineering Team maintains repo:checkout-service-repo (github.com/aegis/checkout-service) and repo:payment-gateway-repo (github.com/aegis/payment-gateway).

questions.question: Which services have direct dependencies on third-party carrier gateways or external APIs?
expected_facts: SMS Relay Gateway integrates carrier APIs (Twilio).
Tax Calculation Service integrates external tax engines (Avalara).
CRM Sync Service connects to external CRM software (HubSpot).
questions.reference_answer: Services interfacing with external or third-party providers include the SMS Relay Gateway (carrier gateways/Twilio), Tax Calculation Service (Avalara adapter), and CRM Sync Service (HubSpot integration).

questions.question: What services have adopted gRPC communication protocols according to architecture decision records?
expected_facts: ADR-102 mandates strict protobuf gRPC protocols between Checkout Service and Payment Gateway.
questions.reference_answer: According to ADR-102, the Checkout Service and Payment Gateway Service communicate using strict gRPC protobuf protocols for low-latency payment processing.
